title: O God of Love! with Cheering Ray
description: O God of Love! with Cheering Ray in Tonic Solfa to MELCOMBE, doh is Eb: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: These words were printed without an author's name in Hymns for Christian Devotion, compiled by John G. Adams and Edwin H. Chapin (Boston, 1846), as hymn 535 of its twenty-second edition (1853), “Deliverance from the Fear of Death”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Long Metre (8.8.8.8), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to MELCOMBE; any other Long Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O God of love! with cheer-ing ray, Gild our ex-pir-ing hour of day; Thy love, through each re-volv-ing year, Has wiped a-way af-flic-tion's tear.

lines: O God of love! with cheering ray,
Gild our expiring hour of day;
Thy love, through each revolving year,
Free us from death's terrific gloom,
And all the fear which shrouds the tomb;
Heighten our joys, support our head,
Before we sink among the dead.
May death conclude our toils and tears!
May death destroy our sins and fears!
May death, through Jesus, be our friend!
May death be life, when life shall end!
Crown our last moment with thy power —
The latest in our latest hour;
Till to the raptured heights we soar,
Where fears and death are known no more.
